title: First Purchase Guide: How to Choose Size and Material
excerpt: A practical path for first-time buyers: budget, body size, material feel, and shipping expectations.

sections.heading: Start from total landed budget
sections.body: Do not only compare factory price. Include international freight, destination fees, and optional functions before deciding.

sections.heading: Size affects both handling and shipping
sections.body: 100-130cm models are easier for storage and lower-risk first orders. 149-171cm models provide stronger realism but are heavier and more expensive to ship.

sections.heading: Pick one must-have, then control options
sections.body: Choose one key preference (for example: skin texture, standing feet, implanted hair), then keep other add-ons minimal to avoid budget overflow.

title: TPE vs Silicone: Cost, Touch, and Maintenance
excerpt: Photo-backed comparison plus why our shop focuses on premium silicone for long-term ownership.

sections.heading: How to read this guide
sections.body: Below you’ll see real reference photos: the first pair is TPE, the second pair is silicone. Use them alongside the notes on cost, touch, and care—not as a substitute for hygiene and storage discipline.

sections.heading: Price and entry threshold
sections.body: TPE often wins on sticker price and can feel like a lower-risk first purchase. Silicone costs more up front and shipping weight/volume usually pushes landed cost higher—but many owners treat that as a long-term investment in stability, detail retention, and simpler day-to-day care.

sections.heading: Visual reference: TPE samples
sections.body: TPE can look soft and approachable in photos, but the surface is more oil-dependent and stain-sensitive in daily use. Finer areas may also need more frequent powdering or touch-up to keep a consistent look under real lighting.

sections.heading: Why choose silicone from RealDollHub
sections.body: We standardize on silicone because it matches what most experienced collectors want after the first purchase: cleaner surface behavior, better long-term shape retention, and a premium tactile read under normal room lighting. Our listings are curated for consistent factory finishing, discreet fulfillment, and clear lead-time communication—so you’re not guessing what arrives at your door.

sections.heading: Touch, detail, and daily care
sections.body: If you prioritize softness above all, some TPE blends can feel plush—but silicone usually returns a more ‘settled’ skin texture with less maintenance theater. Both materials require thorough cleaning and full drying; silicone is generally more forgiving on stains and compression marks if you avoid harsh solvents and store without long-term point pressure.

sections.heading: Maintenance rhythm (quick checklist)
sections.body: After each use: clean with a mild, manufacturer-safe routine, dry completely, and return to a breathable, dust-light space. Monthly: inspect high-contact areas, joints, and any coated zones. Silicone owners typically spend less time fighting oil bleed or surface tack than with many TPE setups—another reason we recommend silicone for buyers who want fewer variables over years, not weeks.

title: Care Routine: Weekly and Monthly Checklist
excerpt: A maintenance SOP to keep product condition stable and reduce after-sales issues.

sections.heading: Weekly basic care
sections.body: Surface cleaning, dry wipe, and quick visual check for high-contact zones.

sections.heading: Monthly deep care
sections.body: Joint movement check, powder or surface condition refresh, wig and accessory organization.

sections.heading: Storage discipline
sections.body: Keep in dry, low-dust space. Avoid direct sunlight and long-term pressure on one side.

title: Warehouse vs Origin Delivery: Which Route Fits You
excerpt: Understand the trade-off between faster regional inventory and wider origin options.

sections.heading: Regional warehouse route
sections.body: Usually faster final-mile delivery, limited model options, and region-dependent stock.

sections.heading: Origin route
sections.body: Wider model selection and option combinations, but international freight and customs timeline vary by destination.

sections.heading: How to decide
sections.body: If timeline is priority, prefer local warehouse when available. If model customization is priority, origin route is usually better.

title: Half Body vs Full Body: Usage Scenario Playbook
excerpt: Choose based on space, handling, and use intensity instead of only body type preference.

sections.heading: Half body advantages
sections.body: Lower space requirement, easier handling, and lower shipping baseline.

sections.heading: Full body advantages
sections.body: Stronger visual completeness and broader presentation scenarios.

sections.heading: Decision shortcut
sections.body: For first order and tight storage, start with half body. For long-term collection intent, choose full body.

title: Optional Functions: What Is Worth Paying For
excerpt: Prioritize options by conversion value instead of adding everything.

sections.heading: High-impact options first
sections.body: Focus on options that directly change your daily experience, such as preferred hair type or key body function.

sections.heading: Avoid stacked low-value add-ons
sections.body: Multiple minor options can exceed budget quickly without clear utility gain.

sections.heading: Use a one-page option plan
sections.body: Before order confirmation, lock one must-have, one nice-to-have, and one optional fallback.

title: Privacy and Discreet Delivery: What to Expect
excerpt: A clear expectation-setting note for packaging, communication, and delivery checkpoints.

sections.heading: Outer packaging
sections.body: No sensitive labels on package exterior. Keep receiver contact details accurate to avoid exception handling calls.

sections.heading: Communication flow
sections.body: You will receive confirmation before final freight quote and payment completion.

sections.heading: After-delivery checks
sections.body: Inspect package condition, then do a basic product status check within the first day.

title: Starter Bundle Recommendations by Budget
excerpt: Three practical bundle ideas to reduce decision fatigue for first-time buyers.

sections.heading: Entry bundle
sections.body: Start with one compact model plus basic care items and minimal add-ons.

sections.heading: Balanced bundle
sections.body: Choose a 149-159cm class model with one major optional function and a maintenance schedule.

sections.heading: Premium bundle
sections.body: For long-term use, prioritize higher-grade texture model and strict post-delivery care routine.
